// CASE dart_local_final_closure_param_shadow expect=pass
Future<void> closureParam(List<Plan> plans) async {
  final limit = 1;
  await probe(limit);
  await Future.wait(plans.map((plan) async {
    final limit = plan.limit;
    await mapWithConcurrency(plan.items, limit, save);
  }));
}
// CASE dart_inner_block_shadow expect=pass
Future<void> innerBlock(List<int> items, Config config) async {
  final width = 1;
  await probe(width);
  if (config.parallel) {
    final width = config.width;
    await mapWithConcurrency(items, width, save);
  }
}
// CASE dart_for_in_shadow expect=pass
Future<void> forIn(List<int> items, List<int> widths) async {
  final width = 1;
  await probe(width);
  await Future.wait([
    for (final width in widths) mapWithConcurrency(items, width, save),
  ]);
}
